question: What code would break if I change assembleCodeContext?
gold: assembleCodeContext (src/mcp/codeContext.ts) is called by EmbeddedLoreReader.loadContext (src/mcp/embeddedReader.ts); changing it affects how the code-intelligence read tools (call_graph, blast_radius, find_dead_code, hotspots, layer_violations, schema_drift) assemble their {table, relations} context.

question: Which functions call resolveCodeReader?
gold: resolveCodeReader (src/mcp/loreReaderFactory.ts) is called by the code-intelligence tool handlers in src/mcp/allTools.ts — the call_graph, find_dead_code, blast_radius, hotspots, layer_violations, schema_drift, alerts and schema handlers each call it to pick the read transport.

question: What breaks if I change the EmbeddedLore class?
gold: EmbeddedLore (src/lore/embeddedLore.ts) is opened by EmbeddedLore.open in the CLI index path (src/cli.ts) and by getEmbeddedLore in the per-workspace registry (src/mcp/embeddedRegistry.ts); the registry is used by the read path (embeddedReader.ts) and the index/knowledge tools in allTools.ts. Changing it affects all embedded reads, writes, supersede, and maintenance.

question: Which symbols in the codebase are dead (zero inbound references)?
gold: The dead-code set is the symbols with zero inbound references (callable kinds, non-exempt names) in the indexed graph — e.g. unused analytics helpers such as tectonicMap when nothing imports them. A correct answer enumerates the actual zero-inbound symbols.
